requirementSpec.intent: Build a polished Roblox main menu titled AURORA. Features: Play, Settings, Credits. Settings opens a panel with Music on/off toggle and Volume slider. Credits opens a small panel. Both panels have Close. Desktop and mobile. Rich glossy cyan/cobalt artwork with thick navy edges, warm gold highlights, ornamental corner details and a title plate. Use Gemini-generated matching skins and icons: button skins, panel skin, slider track and handle, toggle on/off pieces and distinct play/settings/credits/close icons. Keep text live and readable. Create only these features; no shop, rewards, currency, ranks or invented game systems. Play closes the menu and fires a clearly named local hook for game integration. Coherent hover and press animation. Native background layout with restrained decoration. Panels must open and close in the actual controller.

designPlan.artDirection: AURORA is framed as a premium fantasy-sci-fi lobby with glossy cyan and cobalt enamel surfaces, thick navy edging, and restrained warm gold trim used only for highlights, corner filigree, and emphasis around the title plate. The composition avoids a full outer menu panel so the native background can breathe; instead, the title plate crowns a centered vertical action dock, while modal panels float above with matching framed skins. Gemini-generated artwork should form a cohesive kit: one primary button skin for Play, one shared secondary button skin for Settings and Credits, one shared close-button skin, one shared panel skin for both modals, one title-plate ornament, one corner-ornament image reused sparingly, one slider track skin, one slider handle skin, and matching toggle on/off pieces. Surfaces should feel polished and layered through internal gradients, beveled edge lighting, and controlled specular streaks, but text remains live, clean, and high-contrast without heavy outlining. The mood is readable and heroic rather than noisy: restrained background decoration, balanced negative space, and obvious primary-action dominance for Play.

composition.focalPoint: The dominant focal point is the large Play button centered in the main vertical dock beneath the AURORA title plate. Settings and Credits sit directly below as coordinated primary menu actions in the same dock, but remain visually subordinate through smaller scale. When opened, the Settings or Credits modal becomes the temporary focal layer, centered above the dock with its close control aligned in the panel header so users always understand how to dismiss it.
secondaryRegions: nonvisual integration systems for play hook and panel controller
composition.alignmentSystem: Use a centered vertical axis for title and main actions on desktop and mobile, with all major controls snapping to a shared width rhythm. Modal content aligns to a simple single-column interior grid: header row, content rows, then close action. Ornament placement mirrors top-left and bottom-right corners of the safe area for balance without crowding actionable areas. Keep all comparable menu buttons in one dock with equal widths and consistent icon/text alignment.

visualSystem.colorRationale: Cyan is the luminous lead for primary affordances and glossy fill highlights, cobalt supports secondary actions and panel body depth, navy provides the thick structural edge treatment, and warm gold is reserved for trim, corner filigree, title accents, and small emphasis strokes so it reads as premium rather than overwhelming. Background remains deep and restrained to keep bright controls forward. Text uses near-white and cool desaturated blue-gray for strong readability over saturated art.
visualSystem.outlineStyle: Primary surfaces use thick navy outer strokes with a subtle inner gold or cyan highlight line baked into artwork where appropriate. Native text containers and rows use thin UIStroke only when needed for separation; avoid outlining all text. Rounded corners progress from small row elements to broader modal and title framing.
visualSystem.shadowStyle: Use short, dense navy-black drop shadows for buttons and panels with modest vertical offset, plus a soft ambient shadow beneath modal windows. Buttons get tighter shadows than panels so the stack feels crisp and polished rather than floaty.

display.treatment: Used only for the live AURORA title centered on the title plate with slight tracking and no heavy outline; rely on contrast and plate framing.

heading.treatment: Panel titles and major section labels use confident bold weight with high contrast and restrained spacing.

button.treatment: Action labels are large, centered vertically, and paired with icons; maintain readability over glossy skins with clean fill and no image text.

caption.treatment: Used for compact supporting text and slider value text if shown live.

numeric.treatment: Used for live volume value text with tabular feel and strong legibility.

badge.treatment: Reserved but minimally used; if any micro-label treatment is needed, keep compact and crisp.

iconSystem.styleDescription: Gemini-generated icon family with distinct play, settings, credits, and close symbols designed to sit inside the same glossy fantasy-sci-fi UI kit. Icons should read cleanly at small sizes, use bold silhouettes, and harmonize with thick navy edges and warm gold gleams.

motionSystem.hover: Desktop hover uses a restrained premium response: 1.03 scale max, 2-4 px upward lift, slight brightening of glossy highlight, and a soft shadow increase. Only actionable controls receive hover feedback.
motionSystem.press: Press uses a quick inward scale to about 0.97, tiny downward offset, and compressed highlight/shadow for a tactile enamel-button feel. Slider handle compresses subtly during drag.
motionSystem.entrance: At screen load, title plate and button dock fade and rise in together with a small stagger from top to bottom. Modals fade/scale in from 0.96 to 1 with a soft upward settle; background ornaments remain mostly static.
motionSystem.release: Controls rebound cleanly to rest with a brief eased return. Modal close uses a short fade and slight scale-down before visibility is removed.
motionSystem.reducedMotion: When reduced motion is preferred, remove lift and stagger, keep only fast opacity changes and minimal scale deltas. Drag behavior remains functional with no extra animation beyond state updates.
motionSystem.touchBehavior: Touch devices use Activated and drag interactions only, showing press feedback immediately on touch down and no synthetic hover. Maintain the same hierarchy but simplify motion to crisp scale and opacity responses.

audioSystem.touchBehavior: No hover or click audio is played on touch or pointer devices because sounds were not requested.
audioSystem.fallbackBehavior: If a downstream implementation wants optional UI sounds later, unresolved audio must remain silent rather than claiming fulfillment.

responsiveStrategy.desktop: Build _NexusDesktop with BackgroundRoot and BackgroundOrnaments filling the screen, TitlePlate and AuroraTitle centered near the upper third, and MainMenuDock centered below as a vertical stack. Keep modal windows centered overlays above the dock with fixed maximum widths so the composition feels premium and not stretched. Play remains visually dominant through larger button size, not by icon mismatch or arbitrary color changes.
responsiveStrategy.mobile: Build _NexusMobile separately with the same semantic node names under the mobile group. Use a narrower title plate, full-width stacked buttons, larger touch targets, reduced ornament scale, and modals that consume more width while keeping the same visual hierarchy. Do not simply scale down desktop; reflow the dock and increase vertical efficiency. Runtime selects mobile when min(viewport.X, viewport.Y) < 600.
responsiveStrategy.tablet: Use the desktop group when viewport minimum dimension is 600 or greater, but tighten widths slightly compared with wide desktop and allow modal panels to scale a bit larger relative to the screen. Maintain centered composition and preserve primary-action dominance without introducing new navigation patterns.

implementationNotes: Use the exact supported node names from the library template and instantiate all initial instances by View.build() return under _NexusDesktop and _NexusMobile root groups.
Keep BackgroundRoot as a native full-screen background and MainMenuDock transparent; do not add an outer menu panel.
TitlePlate and BackgroundOrnaments should each map to one artwork image source, preserving restrained decoration.
PlayButton uses the primary Gemini skin; SettingsButton and CreditsButton share one secondary skin; SettingsCloseButton and CreditsCloseButton share one close skin and one close icon.
SettingsModal and CreditsModal share one Gemini panel skin, with CreditsModal sized smaller in layout rather than requiring a separate artwork family.

MusicToggle and VolumeSlider are the only planned controls; use control_artwork treatment and let resolver derive their moving artwork pieces from the planned components rather than adding extra component entries.
Keep all labels and titles as live Roblox text, including AURORA, Settings, Credits, Music, Volume, Close, and any volume value text.

PanelControllerBehavior must implement actual open/close state: open_settings_panel shows SettingsModal and hides CreditsModal, open_credits_panel shows CreditsModal and hides SettingsModal, close actions hide their respective modal.
PlayButton behavior must close the menu and then fire the clearly named local hook represented by OnPlayRequestedHook; do not invent remote systems.
Use local helper functions inside View for repeated UI construction; runtime interaction effects should call into a shared ButtonEffects module rather than duplicating per-button logic.
On touch devices, use Activated and direct drag for slider input; do not synthesize mouse hover.
Apply UIAspectRatioConstraint to ornamental artwork, title plate, close buttons if needed, and slider handle/track artwork pieces so skins preserve intended shape.
Use CanvasGroup for modal fade transitions and to simplify visible/input gating during open and close animations.
If credits text content is not otherwise specified, leave a clear live placeholder-style body string suitable for later replacement rather than inventing extra systems or lore.
No audio assets should be fabricated because sounds were not requested; leave interaction silent.
All icon-enabled menu actions in the main dock and both close buttons must use the same aurora_gemini family and identical icon sizing rules within their comparable groups.

visualSystem.colorRationale: Cyan is the luminous lead for primary affordances and glossy fill highlights, cobalt supports secondary actions and panel body depth, navy provides the thick structural edge treatment, and warm gold is reserved for trim, corner filigree, title accents, and small emphasis strokes so it reads as premium rather than overwhelming. Background remains deep and restrained to keep bright controls forward. Text uses near-white and cool desaturated blue-gray for strong readability over saturated art.
visualSystem.outlineStyle: Primary surfaces use thick navy outer strokes with a subtle inner gold or cyan highlight line baked into artwork where appropriate. Native text containers and rows use thin UIStroke only when needed for separation; avoid outlining all text. Rounded corners progress from small row elements to broader modal and title framing.
visualSystem.shadowStyle: Use short, dense navy-black drop shadows for buttons and panels with modest vertical offset, plus a soft ambient shadow beneath modal windows. Buttons get tighter shadows than panels so the stack feels crisp and polished rather than floaty.

display.treatment: Used only for the live AURORA title centered on the title plate with slight tracking and no heavy outline; rely on contrast and plate framing.

heading.treatment: Panel titles and major section labels use confident bold weight with high contrast and restrained spacing.

button.treatment: Action labels are large, centered vertically, and paired with icons; maintain readability over glossy skins with clean fill and no image text.

body.treatment: Used for credits body and settings row labels with high contrast and simple line spacing.

caption.treatment: Used for compact supporting text and slider value text if shown live.

numeric.treatment: Used for live volume value text with tabular feel and strong legibility.

badge.treatment: Reserved but minimally used; if any micro-label treatment is needed, keep compact and crisp.

iconSystem.styleDescription: Gemini-generated icon family with distinct play, settings, credits, and close symbols designed to sit inside the same glossy fantasy-sci-fi UI kit. Icons should read cleanly at small sizes, use bold silhouettes, and harmonize with thick navy edges and warm gold gleams.

motionSystem.hover: Desktop hover uses a restrained premium response: 1.03 scale max, 2-4 px upward lift, slight brightening of glossy highlight, and a soft shadow increase. Only actionable controls receive hover feedback.
motionSystem.press: Press uses a quick inward scale to about 0.97, tiny downward offset, and compressed highlight/shadow for a tactile enamel-button feel. Slider handle compresses subtly during drag.
motionSystem.entrance: At screen load, title plate and button dock fade and rise in together with a small stagger from top to bottom. Modals fade/scale in from 0.96 to 1 with a soft upward settle; background ornaments remain mostly static.
motionSystem.release: Controls rebound cleanly to rest with a brief eased return. Modal close uses a short fade and slight scale-down before visibility is removed.
motionSystem.reducedMotion: When reduced motion is preferred, remove lift and stagger, keep only fast opacity changes and minimal scale deltas. Drag behavior remains functional with no extra animation beyond state updates.
motionSystem.touchBehavior: Touch devices use Activated and drag interactions only, showing press feedback immediately on touch down and no synthetic hover. Maintain the same hierarchy but simplify motion to crisp scale and opacity responses.

audioSystem.touchBehavior: No hover or click audio is played on touch or pointer devices because sounds were not requested.
audioSystem.fallbackBehavior: If a downstream implementation wants optional UI sounds later, unresolved audio must remain silent rather than claiming fulfillment.

responsiveStrategy.desktop: Build _NexusDesktop with BackgroundRoot and BackgroundOrnaments filling the screen, TitlePlate and AuroraTitle centered near the upper third, and MainMenuDock centered below as a vertical stack. Keep modal windows centered overlays above the dock with fixed maximum widths so the composition feels premium and not stretched. Play remains visually dominant through larger button size, not by icon mismatch or arbitrary color changes.
responsiveStrategy.mobile: Build _NexusMobile separately with the same semantic node names under the mobile group. Use a narrower title plate, full-width stacked buttons, larger touch targets, reduced ornament scale, and modals that consume more width while keeping the same visual hierarchy. Do not simply scale down desktop; reflow the dock and increase vertical efficiency. Runtime selects mobile when min(viewport.X, viewport.Y) < 600.
responsiveStrategy.tablet: Use the desktop group when viewport minimum dimension is 600 or greater, but tighten widths slightly compared with wide desktop and allow modal panels to scale a bit larger relative to the screen. Maintain centered composition and preserve primary-action dominance without introducing new navigation patterns.

implementationNotes: Use the exact supported node names from the library template and instantiate all initial instances by View.build() return under _NexusDesktop and _NexusMobile root groups.
Keep BackgroundRoot as a native full-screen background and MainMenuDock transparent; do not add an outer menu panel.
TitlePlate and BackgroundOrnaments should each map to one artwork image source, preserving restrained decoration.
PlayButton uses the primary Gemini skin; SettingsButton and CreditsButton share one secondary skin; SettingsCloseButton and CreditsCloseButton share one close skin and one close icon.
SettingsModal and CreditsModal share one Gemini panel skin, with CreditsModal sized smaller in layout rather than requiring a separate artwork family.

MusicToggle and VolumeSlider are the only planned controls; use control_artwork treatment and let resolver derive their moving artwork pieces from the planned components rather than adding extra component entries.
Keep all labels and titles as live Roblox text, including AURORA, Settings, Credits, Music, Volume, Close, and any volume value text.

PanelControllerBehavior must implement actual open/close state: open_settings_panel shows SettingsModal and hides CreditsModal, open_credits_panel shows CreditsModal and hides SettingsModal, close actions hide their respective modal.
PlayButton behavior must close the menu and then fire the clearly named local hook represented by OnPlayRequestedHook; do not invent remote systems.
Use local helper functions inside View for repeated UI construction; runtime interaction effects should call into a shared ButtonEffects module rather than duplicating per-button logic.
On touch devices, use Activated and direct drag for slider input; do not synthesize mouse hover.
Apply UIAspectRatioConstraint to ornamental artwork, title plate, close buttons if needed, and slider handle/track artwork pieces so skins preserve intended shape.
Use CanvasGroup for modal fade transitions and to simplify visible/input gating during open and close animations.
If credits text content is not otherwise specified, leave a clear live placeholder-style body string suitable for later replacement rather than inventing extra systems or lore.
No audio assets should be fabricated because sounds were not requested; leave interaction silent.
All icon-enabled menu actions in the main dock and both close buttons must use the same aurora_gemini family and identical icon sizing rules within their comparable groups.

changeInstructions: Create a main menu titled AURORA with Play, Settings, and Credits.
Add a Settings panel containing a Music on/off toggle and Volume slider.
Ensure Play closes the menu and fires a clearly named local hook for game integration.
Implement coherent hover and press animation.
Use native background layout with restrained decoration.
Use Gemini-generated matching skins and icons for the specified components.
Ensure panels open and close through the actual controller logic.
